HOME.INTRO: From now on you sign in with your email and password. We will get your company ready for its audit, step by step.
HOME.COMPANY_TITLE: Let's get to know your company
HOME.COMPANY_BODY: A few simple questions about your business. It takes a couple of minutes.
HOME.SERVICE_BODY: The service you want to audit. When you finish, your compliance catalog will be ready.
HOME.COMPANY_SERVICE_KNOWN: We already know your company and your service
HOME.ASSETS_BODY: Tell us where your service lives and connect it so Monkey can assess it on its own. You can do it in parts.
HOME.ALL_READY_TITLE: Your company and your service are ready
HOME.ALL_READY_BODY: Your compliance catalog is ready and we already know where your service lives. You can review or edit what you told us, and register more assets whenever you like.
